propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER plan-review criterion (decomp-shape) must detect two decomposition-shape smells: layer-cake architectural partitioning and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns.

The criterion integrates into the existing container fan-out via CONTAINER_CRITERIA list at pass1.py, routed through pass1_container with per-child attribution, requiring no new engine pass or construct.
The criterion ships as advisory-only posture; blocking promotion is deferred pending E6 order-stability (fleiss_kappa floor) and dogfood effectiveness signals above a calibration threshold.

Bounded sanity evaluation via hand-authored fixtures (layer-cake and consumed-artifact positives; vertical-slice and ordered negatives) must demonstrate recall 1.0 on positives and false-accept 0.0 on negatives.

The criterion must be registered in registry.CANONICAL_LLM and registry.AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), routed in criteria_routing.json with exec:AGENT, facet:container, and default_posture:advisory, with a corresponding rubric prompt and regenerated guide section.
